units.source_text: 只要世界或我们的任何一方发生变化，将我们和世界置于对立状态的可怕的不满，就应该可以消除。

en.t: As long as either the world or we ourselves changed, the terrible dissatisfaction that set us against the world ought to disappear.

units.source_text: 但是，我憎恨幻想变化的梦想，我讨厌非同寻常的梦想。

en.t: But I hated dreams that imagined change, and I detested extraordinary dreams.

units.source_text: 然而钻"假如世界变化，我就不存在；

en.t: Yet if I pursued the theoretical dead end that said, "If the world changes, I will no longer exist;

units.source_text: 假如我变化，世界也就不存在"这种理论式的牛角尖所获得的确信，

en.t: if I change, the world too will no longer exist," the conviction gained from that line of reasoning

units.source_text: 反而会似是一种和解、一种融洽。

en.t: would, on the contrary, seem like a kind of reconciliation, a kind of harmony.

units.source_text: 因为实事求是的我不会被人爱的这种思考，与世界是不能共存的。

en.t: For the thought that the realistic, truth-facing me could never be loved by others could not coexist with the world.

units.source_text: 于是，残疾人最后落入的陷讲，不是消除对立状态，而是以全面承认对立状态的形式出现。

en.t: Thus the trap into which a disabled person finally falls appears not as the elimination of opposition, but as the complete acceptance of it.

units.source_text: 这样，残疾就是不治之症了……

en.t: In this way, disability becomes an incurable disease...
